name: retro
description: Close a work session properly: reconcile it against the wider collaboration, inventory what was actually built from git log and recently-touched files, summarize the arc, classify each artifact as keep, one-off or promote-to-permanent, route the durable ones to memory, canon or a new skill, save the retro as a vault note, and hand back an enriched /compact block so working memory shrinks without losing the thread. Triggers: "/retro", "/rr", "wrap up the session".
